BiblicalUsage: Bakbuk is named among the Nethinim, the temple servants whose children returned from exile with Zerubbabel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the servants of the house are written down with the rest, and Bakbuk's name is kept because he belonged to the Lord's work.
